additionalProperties.value: OSOS_ABORT_ENTRY: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Writes the logical 64-bit file position, accounting for buffered input/output; returns zero or the underlying file error.
OSOS_PANIC_ENTRY: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.

Copies a media entry into a destination list at a validated insertion cursor; returns NULL for invalid inputs. Delegates to 0x080afbfc. The callee accesses list flags at +0x130/+0x131; 2.0.4 uses +0x18c/+0x18d. Do not reuse the 2.0.4 list layout.
Notifies dependents, unlinks TrackData, destroys its pools and caches through 080b8de4, then frees the owner.
Calls TrackData_DestroyStorage. CFW clears retained metadata before native caches and record pools are freed.
Reads the album token at record+34 from the owner's cache at +1c8. Writes a counted UTF-16 string of at most 255 units and returns cache-read status.
Reads the artist token at record+2c from the owner's cache at +118. Writes a counted UTF-16 string of at most 255 units and returns cache-read status.
Reads the composer token at record+3c from the owner's cache at +118. Writes a counted UTF-16 string of at most 255 units and returns cache-read status.
Reads the genre token at record+40 from the owner's cache at +278. Writes a counted UTF-16 string of at most 255 units and returns cache-read status.
Reads the grouping token at record+38 from the owner's cache at +220. Writes a counted UTF-16 string of at most 255 units and returns cache-read status.
Reads the title token at record+28 from the owner's cache at +c0. Writes a counted UTF-16 string of at most 255 units and returns cache-read status.
Returns bit 0 of the SysInfo flags at +0x94.
OSOS_REGIONAL_VOLUME_RESULT_WORD: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
OSOS_HEAP_REGION_BASE_LITERAL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
If the database service is available, increments update nesting for its component stores. Paired with MediaDatabase_EndUpdate. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08051348.
Releases a default-heap allocation and updates accounting. Null is ignored; invalid allocation headers abort.
Allocates zero-filled storage from the default heap using tag 4; returns the pointer or null.
Loads native preferences, migrates older formats, and sets preference initialization flags.
OSOS_PREFERENCES_LOAD_CALL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Calls ITunesDB_ImportTrackDataset with the reader in r0. CFW initializes shared Album Artist metadata before importing tracks.
If the database service is available, decrements positive update nesting for its component stores. Paired with MediaDatabase_BeginUpdate. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x080611e0.
Advances the file at reader+40000 by byte_count. Negative counts seek backward relative to the current position; returns file status.
Writes the saved EQ settings ID for a menu index through the output pointer; returns -50 for a null output.
OSOS_EQ_MENU_IDS_LITERAL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Initializes the runtime heap using the lower bound at 080657dc; stock lower bound is 08b21e30.
OSOS_RUNTIME_HEAP_BASE_LITERAL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Imports the track dataset into TrackData at reader+40004. Track IDs occupy record+110/+114; track/disc totals are +86/+8a. MHOD 22 is discarded through slot 080744d0. Returns zero or an import error.
MHOD 22 dispatch slot; stock word ea000146 branches to discard at 080749f0. CFW passes r7 reader, r4 record and SP+228 minus SP+224 body bytes, then resumes at 08074598 with r0 status.
Frees token, reference, backing and hash-index storage, then clears the 58-byte cache. Returns zero or -50 for an invalid cache.
Returns 1 for a non-null cache with the native signature, otherwise 0.
Copies up to capacity bytes from a valid cache token and reports bytes copied. Token zero is empty. Temporarily increments read-access counter +30; returns zero or -50.
OSOS_EQ_MAP_ENTRY: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Copies at most 510 bytes into output+1 and stores the UTF-16 unit count in output[0]. Returns the cache-read status.
Reads the 16-byte string header and payload, converts encoding as requested and retains it in the supplied cache. Optionally collects glyphs; returns zero or an error.
Releases a retained token and marks unreferenced storage dead. Returns -50 when read access is active or flag 40 freezes reference accounting.
OSOS_EQ_SETTINGS_COUNT_WORD: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
OSOS_EQ_SETTINGS_IDS_LITERAL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.

Copies or recursively inserts a media entry, applying duplicate suppression and notifying the destination list. List flags are at +0x130/+0x131, versus +0x18c/+0x18d in the reviewed 2.0.4 counterpart 0x080c69c4. Other list fields require separate verification.
2.0.1 list flags at +0x130; corresponding 2.0.4 access uses +0x18c.
2.0.1 list order flags at +0x131; corresponding 2.0.4 access uses +0x18d.
Frees the hash index when forced or flags 4 and 8 are set; clears flag 4 and sets flag 40. Retained string tokens remain readable.
Imports one MHOD string via ITunesDB_DecodeCachedString with reserved argument zero. Returns status and writes the cache token.
Destroys record pools and native string caches, including Artist/Composer at +118, and clears record counts. Leaves the TrackData allocation intact.
Order field 0x1000 compares unsigned song shuffle ranks at entry +0x24; group entries are distinguished by byte +0x1d bit 0. Mode 2 selects this field.
Frees and clears cached indexes for order modes 1..48. Entry-array cache base is list+0x34c, so mode 2 uses +0x354; 2.0.4 uses +0x3b4. Auxiliary caches for modes 6, 7, 9 and 24 are also invalidated.
Finalizes registered caches, releases eligible reference-count arrays, compacts storage and empties the registration list. Flag 40 freezes token releases; returns zero.
OSOS_GAME_MANIFEST_INIT_CALL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Allocates the resource override map and stores it at bank+0x18. Called by UI_InitResourceProviders before constructing resource providers. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08111d0c.
Lazily constructs and returns the 0x54-byte Genius service. Its layout differs from the 0x58-byte 2.0.4 service. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08121854.
Fills a media item from the Genius list at +0x4c; leaves output unchanged when the list is absent. 2.0.4 uses list field +0x30. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08121884.
Subtracts two header rows when service byte +0x44 is zero, otherwise one. 2.0.4 reads the corresponding flag at +0x54. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08121f88.
Writes the current media item using player slot 16c with the current index at +5c. This method occupies player vtable slot 158.
Under the player lock at +0xa4c, releases the prepared track at +0x58 and clears its pointer. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08171110; these player offsets match.
Lazily allocates and constructs the 0xa6c-byte media player and returns the cached singleton at 0x089a012c. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08171fdc.
OSOS_EQ_TRACK_GUARD_WORD: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Returns the default resource bank from the initialized resource service, or NULL when the service is unavailable. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08194ed8.
OSOS_RESOURCE_NEXT_TEMPLATE_CALL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Constructs and registers the UI resource-provider chain. Gets the default resource bank and initializes its override map before constructing providers. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x081c73d0.
Initializes the resource override map before provider construction. 2.0.4 payload hook counterpart: 0x081c7410.
OSOS_RESOURCE_INIT_CALL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Lazily creates and returns the screen controller registry singleton.
Resolves the screen definition and creates its controller for the requested layout and push mode. Aborts if construction fails.
OSOS_EQ_PREVIEW_COUNT_WORD: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Returns the preview resource for EQ menu indices 0..22 from the odd word of each table pair.
OSOS_EQ_PREVIEW_TABLE_LITERAL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
OSOS_EQ_NAME_COUNT_WORD: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Returns the localized name resource for EQ menu indices 0..22 from the even word of each table pair.
OSOS_EQ_NAME_TABLE_LITERAL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
OSOS_EQ_PROVIDER_COUNT_WORD: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Initializes caller-provided text row storage. A zero submenu flag selects kind 2 (plain text); nonzero selects kind 5 (submenu). Returns the initialized row.
Dispatches named Now Playing actions including contextual menu, album, artist and On-The-Go operations. Argument deadbeef queries support; recognized actions return 1. Action text is read-only.
Builds and pushes the current song's context menu. Reads the player item through slot 158 and appends Cancel at 081f9948. Returns 1.
Appends Cancel to the Now Playing context menu; CFW inserts Song Info immediately before it.
OSOS_SONG_ACTION_ENTRY: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Dispatches song-list action names; 0xdeadbeef queries support. Unrecognized actions fall through to the base media-list dispatcher. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x082176c0.

Builds the song context menu and saves the highlighted row at controller+0xd4. Item lookup uses model vtable+0x220, versus +0x22c in 2.0.4. Native eligibility omits the 2.0.4 kind-0x200000 check. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08218014.
Appends HandleCancel to the song context menu. 2.0.4 payload hook counterpart: 0x08218188.
OSOS_SONG_CANCEL_APPEND_CALL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
OSOS_GENIUS_ACTION_ENTRY: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Dispatches Genius action names, including save and refresh; 0xdeadbeef queries support. Unrecognized actions fall through to the base media-list dispatcher. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x0821ac80.

Builds the Genius context menu using its row mapper and item getter; saves the highlighted row at controller+0xd4. Native eligibility omits the 2.0.4 kind-0x200000 check. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x0821bc68.
Appends HandleCancel to the Genius context menu. 2.0.4 payload hook counterpart: 0x0821be08.
OSOS_GENIUS_CANCEL_APPEND_CALL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Dispatches settings action strings. Argument 0xdeadbeef queries support without executing; returns 0 for unrecognized actions and 1 for handled actions. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x0821c690.
OSOS_PLAYLIST_ACTION_ENTRY: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Dispatches nested-playlist actions, including clear/save On-The-Go; 0xdeadbeef queries support. Unrecognized actions fall through to the base dispatcher. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x0822d1b8.

Builds the nested-playlist context menu and saves the highlighted row at controller+0xe8. Model list/item slots are +0x1ec/+0x220, versus +0x1f4/+0x22c in 2.0.4. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x0822e550.
Appends HandleCancel to the nested-playlist context menu. 2.0.4 payload hook counterpart: 0x0822e754.
OSOS_PLAYLIST_CANCEL_APPEND_CALL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Lock entry used with player+0xa4c by MediaPlayer_ClearPreparedTrack; branches to 0x082c0b6c. Reviewed 2.0.4 entry: 0x082572d0.
Unlock entry used with player+0xa4c by MediaPlayer_ClearPreparedTrack; branches to 0x082c0bb4. Reviewed 2.0.4 entry: 0x082572d4.
Initializes a 24-byte non-owning media item from the record, resolves its list context and stores mode at +14. Returns item.
Returns the menu-item update service at application service +0x30. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08267464.
Converts the counted UTF-16 input to owned, null-terminated UTF-8. Null text or nonpositive length clears the string.
Initializes the 8-byte native string with vtable 0897c0d0 and null data; returns string.
Restores the native string vtable and releases its owned buffer; returns string.
OSOS_EQ_DSP_COUNT_WORD: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
OSOS_EQ_SET_PRESET_LOAD_CALL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
OSOS_EQ_SET_RATE_LOAD_CALL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
OSOS_EQ_RESOURCE_COUNT_WORD: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
OSOS_EQ_RESOURCE_TABLE_LITERAL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Returns the record's disc number at +88, or zero for an invalid item.
Returns the record's track number at +84, or zero for an invalid item.
Returns the record's milliseconds at +5c, or zero for an invalid item.
Assigns the item's title to the output native string, or an empty string when the item is invalid.
Returns the record's bytes at +70, or zero for an invalid item.
Returns the record's year at +7a, or zero for an invalid item.
Assigns the item's album to the output native string, or an empty string when the item is invalid.
Assigns the item's genre to the output native string, or an empty string when the item is invalid.
Assigns the item's artist to the output native string, or an empty string when the item is invalid.
Validates the item through vtable+8, then tests bit 8 of the 16-bit record field at +0xba. 2.0.4 uses a 32-bit field at +0xbc. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x082990ec.
Returns the record's signed rating byte at +7e, or zero for an invalid item.
Returns the record's kbps at +78, or zero for an invalid item.
Validates the item through vtable+8, then tests mask 0x8062 in the 16-bit record field at +0xba. 2.0.4 uses a 32-bit field at +0xbc. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x082991f0.
Assigns the item's composer to the output native string, or an empty string when the item is invalid.
Assigns the item's grouping to the output native string, or an empty string when the item is invalid.
Validates the item through vtable+8, then returns record byte +0x8f bit 0; returns zero for an invalid item. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x0829969c.
Returns the record's play count at +90, or zero for an invalid item.
Returns the record's skip count at +a0, or zero for an invalid item.
Returns the string's UTF-8 buffer, or the static empty string when data is null. The returned buffer is borrowed.

Returns the playback entry at a validated index, accounting for shuffle and reversal. Uses list root +0x40, flags +0x130/+0x131 and cache +0x34c+4*mode; mode 2 is +0x354. Entry array begins at cache+0x10.
Returns the pointer held by a shared-object handle, or NULL when the handle has no backing object. Used for the song controller model at +0xb4. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x083cb174.
Releases reference-counted string backing storage, preserving the empty-string singleton and freeing storage when its last reference is released. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x083cdc2c.
Initializes a one-pointer string from NUL-terminated text, using shared empty storage for an empty input and allocated storage otherwise. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x083cdc84.
Finds or inserts the string key in a resource-name map and returns its ID slot; new values initialize to zero. ResourceName_GetId supplies map 0x08ac2d24. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x083d0884.
Primary Now Playing action slot points to NowPlaying_DispatchAction at 081f7508.
Secondary Now Playing action slot also points to NowPlaying_DispatchAction at 081f7508.
OSOS_SETTINGS_ACTION_SLOT: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
OSOS_SETTINGS_SECONDARY_ACTION_SLOT: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
OSOS_EQ_PROCESS_SLOT: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Branches to the IRAM reset entry at 0x22008848.

Copies 0xae5c bytes into IRAM at 0x22000000, clears IRAM BSS, relocates the return address, then copies 0x9fad50 bytes into DRAM at 0x08000000 and 0xa84 bytes into 0x089fad50. Restarts through the relocated reset vector.
Clears the startup zero-initialized regions, including 0x12665c bytes of DRAM BSS at 0x089fb7d4.
Initializes the startup stack and branches to OS initialization at 0x220039e0.
